items.title: Carvana (CVNA) Stock May Be 34% Below Fair Value On EPS Rebound
items.summary: Carvana has seen an exceptionally large 3 year share price surge, and with the stock recently changing hands around US$71, the key issue is whether that move is backed by the business’s underlying cash flows. For anyone looking at the online used car platform today, the question is how much of its cash generation is already reflected in that valuation. The share price has climbed by very large multiples over 3 years, which puts fresh focus on whether the current valuation is still in step...

items.title: Record Sales Could Be A Turning Point For Carvana Stock (CVNA)
items.summary: Carvana reported record quarterly results, with retail units rising to 197,325 and 217,385 in recent periods. Adjusted EBITDA reached US$769 million, and gross margin stood at 18.9% despite lower gross profit per car. Management attributes current gross profit pressure to factors such as higher reconditioning costs and lower loan rates, which it describes as temporary.
